chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Aban, from Abu Ismail, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): 'Behold, I am about to exit. May I be your ransom! From where should I bid farewell to the House?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Go to Al-Mustajar between the Stone and the Door, and bid farewell from there. Then go out, and drink from Zamzam. Then depart.' So I said, 'Should I pour [water] upon my head?' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'Do not go near the pouring.'

key_terms.أُوَدِّعُ الْبَيْتَ: To bid farewell to the House (Kaaba)
key_terms.الصَّبَّ: As-Sabb: The act of pouring water over oneself
key_terms.الْمُسْتَجَارَ: Al-Mustajar: The specific spot between the Black Stone and the Door of the Kaaba
key_terms.زَمْزَمَ: Zamzam: The sacred well in Mecca

ai.seo_question: Where and how should one bid farewell to the Kaaba after Tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* establishes the Sunnah of performing Tawaf al-Wada' (farewell circumambulation) specifically at Al-Mustajar, the niche between the Black Stone and the Door of the Kaaba, emphasizing a direct and intimate farewell to the House. The Imam’s instruction to drink from Zamzam immediately after departing highlights the spiritual sustenance associated with the pilgrimage's conclusion, while the prohibition against pouring water on one's head distinguishes this ritual act from general purification or cooling practices, preserving its unique liturgical status.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Aban, from Abu Ismail who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> when I wanted to exit, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! So from where should I bid farewell to the House (Kabah)?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You should go to Al-Mustajar between the (Black) Stone and the Door (of the Kabah), so bid farewell. Then go out, and drink from Zamzam. Then depart’. So I said, ‘Can I pour upon my head?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not go near the pouring’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alia’ ibn Muhammad from af-Hassan ibn Afi from Aban from abu ‘Isma’ii who has said the foffowing:

“I once asked Abu `Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, £ I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, I am about to leave. Wherefrom should I say farewell to the House?’ He (the Imam) said, £ Go to al-Mustajar, between the door and the Black Stone and say farewell from there, then leave and drink water from Zamzam then move on.’ I then asked, £ Can I pour water on my head?’ He (the Imam) said, £ Do not get near pouring.’” NOTE: Fatwa best explains Hadith 4 of this Chapter.
